proposal.reason: Primary change is to open-source test workflow execution and reporting: daily/smoke inputs are now generated from JSON test-family definitions at prepare time, grouping policy is updated (including 1/2/4/8-node and cross-rack rack_nodes scheduling), and summary now builds/uploads a full performance workbook from reconciled raw logs. Source-sanity runner/network validation updates and cache/artifact retention changes are CI execution/reporting behavior, not reviewer-policy workflow automation.
